example:
import { EditorialInlineSearch } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialInlineSearch label="Search your collection" placeholder="Name or card number" onSearch={setQuery} count="12 entries" />
name: EditorialInlineSearch
tagline: A collection's own search row (gh#1439): a visible label, a framed field with a search glyph (max 400px) and a live count at the end. The query is reported after typing settles (`debounce`, default 300ms) or at once on Enter. A named `role="search"` region. Geometry: `--editorial-inline-search-*`; a theme hides the label on narrow screens with `--editorial-inline-search-label-display: none`.
usage: DO keep the query in the URL; the row only reports it.
